We're building an AI-native investing platform that transforms institutional-grade market data into intelligent products for everyday investors.
Our mission is to help investors better understand global financial markets through data, research, and AI. Rather than simply displaying charts or dashboards, we build products that explain what markets are doing, why they're moving, and what options markets may be pricing in.
Behind these products is a high-performance options data platform that processes institutional-grade OPRA market data in real time. We're looking for a curious and ambitious software developer who enjoys building the infrastructure behind next-generation options intelligence products used by investors around the world.
What you will do:
Build software that processes and analyzes institutional-grade OPRA options market data in real time
Develop infrastructure for options chains, Greeks, implied volatility, volatility surfaces, and other options analytics
Build backend services and APIs that power AI-driven options intelligence and investor-facing products
Collaborate closely with quantitative researchers to transform research into production-ready software
Design scalable systems capable of processing millions of real-time options quotes accurately and reliably
Build monitoring and validation tools to ensure the quality and integrity of market data and analytics
Optimize production systems for performance, scalability, and reliability
What we are looking for:
Bachelor’s or Master's in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics,
Financial Engineering,
or another quantitative discipline
1–3 years of software engineering experience
Strong proficiency in C++ for performance-critical applications
Strong Python programming skills
Experience building backend systems and working with concurrent or multithreaded applications
Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and UDP multicast
Strong debugging, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills
Curious, self-driven, and excited about building real-time systems for financial markets
Nice to have:
Experience working with options markets or derivatives
Familiarity with OPRA or institutional options market data
Understanding of options pricing, Greeks, implied volatility, volatility surfaces, or market microstructure
Experience working with OPRA, ITCH, OUCH, FIX, or other exchange market data and order entry protocols
Experience with PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, Docker, or Kubernetes
Experience building financial products, trading systems, or market data platforms
What you will build:
You'll help build a next-generation options intelligence platform that transforms institutional-grade market data into actionable, understandable insights for individual investors. Your software will power real-time options analytics, AI-driven market intelligence, and products used by investors around the world.

The Signal & Measurement team at TikTok Ads owns the full stack of advertising effectiveness — from signal collection and identity resolution to attribution modeling and causal measurement. We build the systems and models that help advertisers worldwide understand and maximize the true business value of their ad spend on TikTok.
Our work sits at the intersection of large-scale machine learning and causal inference, applied at massive scale to answer the hardest question in advertising: "Did this ad actually work?" The team's scope covers four pillars: signal, attribution, identity, and measurement. These outputs directly power downstream ads ranking and delivery models, closing the loop from measurement back to optimization. description_preview:
Requisition Id 16723
Overview:
We are seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate with expertise in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) for multiscale physical systems. This position resides in the Computational Sciences and Engineering Division (
CSED
) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL). CSED focuses on transdisciplinary computational science and analytics at scale to enable scientific discovery across the physical sciences, engineered systems, and biomedicine and health. It provides foundations and advances in quantum information sciences to enable quantum computers, devices, and networked systems. It develops community applications, data assets, and technologies and provides assurance to build knowledge and impact in novel, crosscut-science outcomes.
The selected candidate will join the
Multiscale Materials (MsM)
group within the Advanced Computing Methods for Physical Sciences Section in CSED. The MsM group is dedicated to delivering multiscale, multi-fidelity computational models, systems, and AI/ML tools using algorithms and analytics for materials and related physical sciences for a broad range of energy, transportation, and advanced manufacturing applications. In this role, the postdoctoral researcher will focus on developing foundation models for fluid and plasma dynamics, including aerodynamics, turbulence, and edge/scrape-off-layer transport. This will involve designing efficient and trustworthy ML algorithms for physical systems, scalable data loading and training methods for exascale computing platforms, and model verification and validation. The position offers an excellent opportunity to collaborate with multi-displinary domain scientists and advance large-scale scientific AI/ML models.
Major Duties/Responsibilities:
Research and development of scalable AI, ML, and deep learning models using the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility (OLCF) systems.
Conduct research with scalable transformer-based foundation models with large volumes of spatiotemporal physical data, with a focus on fluid and plasma dynamics.
Collaborate within a multi-disciplinary research environment consisting of computational scientists, experimentalists, and engineers conducting basic and applied research in support of the Laboratory’s missions.
Author peer-reviewed papers, technical papers, reports and proposals for internal and external release as well as represent the organization via technical presentations in workshops and conferences.
Basic Qualifications:
Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Computational Science, or a field closely related to the job duties of this position.
Preferred Qualifications:
Strong background in scientific AI/ML, computational fluid dynamics, turbulence modeling, plasma physics, and edge/scrape-off layer transport.
Demonstrated programming ability and knowledge of Python and/or C++.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and application on high-performance computing (HPC) environments using distributed data or model parallel training.
Experience with multi-physics simulations on HPC and with ML models.
Experience working in a multi-disciplinary research environment.
Demonstrated written and oral communication skills, a proven publication record, and effective interpersonal skills.
Special Requirements:
Applicants cannot have received their Ph.D. more than five years prior to the date of application and must complete all degree requirements before starting their appointment. The appointment length will be for up to 24 months with the potential for extension. Initial appointments and extensions are subject to performance and the availability of funding.
Candidates are asked to submit a detailed cover letter describing their experience relative to the duties and qualifications described in this posting with their application.
Please submit three letters of reference when applying to this position. You can upload these directly to your application or have them sent to postdocrecruitment@ornl.gov with the position title and number referenced in the subject line.

description_preview:
About Excel™
Ranked 6X by Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in America, Excel™ specializes in digital advertising and performance marketing, playing a pivotal role in connecting consumers with brands, at scale. We partner with large strategic brands such as insurance carriers, brokers, and agencies, supplying them with high quality prospects looking for their services. This involves owning and operating top-rated insurance websites that we promote via paid search marketing driving the highest-intent consumers looking to acquire an insurance plan to meet their needs.
Our Vision: Acquiring great customers should be simple.
Our Mission: Helping brands acquire the right customers at scale.
Our Values: E - Embrace Simplicity, X - XL Impact, C - Customer Centric, E - Extreme Ownership, L - Laser Focused.
Our team
At Excel™ we believe remote working is an important way to enable people to achieve their best work while maximizing time efficiency and personal freedom. Our culture is based on team-based performance that is highly aligned but loosely coupled, extreme ownership, growth mindset, curiosity, personal accountability, and we flourish because of the creativity and input from our team members. As an agile and innovative company, we are always looking for our next high performer to help transform the future!
Job Description
We are looking for a senior backend-heavy engineer to help drive our core technical initiatives and build our next generation of high-leverage internal platforms. You will work across major business-critical systems, including
eBid
(our real-time bid management engine that matches traffic buying directly with sellable demand to maximize yield) and
eMax
, an internal intelligence platform combining data insights with automated smart actions for our revenue teams.
Alongside flagship product development, you will play a key role in standardizing our engineering practices: building unified distributed tracing, driving OpenFaaS adoption, enforcing microservice SLAs, and elevating our testing and security posture across all services.
Important Note:
This is an
80/20 backend-focused role
. You will be evaluated primarily on system architecture, microservices standardization, API design, security, and automated testing performance.
Key Responsibilities
Build High-Leverage Revenue Products: Architect key components of eBid (real-time bid management to match inventory with buyer intent) and eMax (internal user tools combining real-time data insights with automated workflow actions).
Standardize Microservices Architecture: Unify our microservices suite across frameworks, patterns, and deployment pipelines, driving adoption of OpenFaaS for event-driven and serverless workloads.
Implement Unified Observability: Architect and deploy an end-to-end distributed tracing system using OpenTracing / OpenTelemetry to ensure deep system visibility and enforce strict service SLAs.
Harden Security & Quality: Level up automated testing coverage (unit, integration, and contract testing) across all backend services while continuously improving our overall application security posture.
Refine Data & API Interfaces: Design resilient RESTful APIs, asynchronous event pipelines, and clean database schemas optimized for business-critical decisioning and internal productivity tools.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work alongside frontend engineers, product managers, and key stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, high-impact solutions.
Lead major initiatives: Take ownership of critical technical projects, such as new product creation, complex database migrations, architectural refactoring, and legacy system modernizations.
Mentor and elevate the team: Guide fellow engineers on backend best practices, fostering a culture of technical mastery, ownership, and continuous engineering improvement.
Qualifications
Expertise in Node, NestJS, TypeScript, and AWS Cloud Services, with a proven ability to deliver scalable, production-ready systems.
Microservices & Serverless Architecture: Hands-on experience standardizing microservice environments and working with FaaS platforms (OpenFaaS, AWS Lambda, or similar event-driven execution models).
Observability & Tracing: Practical experience implementing distributed tracing systems (OpenTracing, OpenTelemetry) and establishing monitoring/alerting around service SLAs.
Database & Messaging Systems: Strong experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL), caching (Redis), and asynchronous messaging queues (AWS SQS, Kafka, or Pub/Sub).
Product-Minded Engineering: Ability to translate complex revenue operations and marketer workflows into clean, automated backend tooling.
Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams.
A self-starter attitude with the confidence to identify and resolve key problems without waiting for direction.
A craftsman mindset, someone with the need of improving their work each and every day.
Nice-to-Have:
Experience with real-time bidding systems, programmatic ad engines, or yield optimization algorithms.
Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS).
Practical adoption of AI tools to enhance engineering velocity and code generation workflows.
Familiarity with performance monitoring tools such as ELK, New Relic/Datadog, Sonar, or Grafana Faro.
Experience with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, using LocalStack, Kafka, OpenAPI, Postman

Direct reports: None

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Intern)
reason: Stack +35; Title fit +6; Entry +15; US +10
description_preview:
Job Summary
Not the "sit in a beanbag and optimise a button" kind.
You'll spend your time in factories, surrounded by machines, noise, forklifts, weird edge cases, and people who know how things really work
Your job is to spot what is broken, figure out why, and build AI workflows to fix it. Some days you will shadow a line operator. Other days you will code a prototype that automates their shift handoff logs. Then you will take it back to the floor, test it with real users, and improve it on the spot.
You are not just an engineer. You are a detective, a translator, and a builder.
What You'll Do
Be on the floor:
Spend 3 to 4 days a week at manufacturing sites, shadowing operators, supervisors, and safety leads.
Learn by watching:
Observe manual workflows, paper based processes, and repetitive tasks that slow people down or create risk.
Identify problems:
Spot inefficiencies, safety gaps, and opportunities where AI could make a real difference.
Build fast:
Use our platform and modern AI tools like LLMs, VLMs, and Python to build MVPs that solve those problems, often within a day or two.
Test and iterate:
Bring your prototypes back to the floor, get real time feedback from operators, and improve them on the spot.
Bridge the gap:
Translate factory floor language into engineering requirements. Explain technical solutions to non technical operators.
What We're Looking For
Comfortable on a factory floor:
You are not afraid of noise, dirt, or steel toe boots. You are curious about how things actually work.
Excellent communicator:
You can talk to operators and managers alike and translate their pain points into technical solutions.
Proactive and curious:
You don't wait for instructions. You ask questions, explore systems, and dig into messy problems until you understand them.
Demonstrable AI coding skills:
You can build a working prototype with LLMs or VLMs in a few hours. Python is your go-to language. You have built something, whether it is a hackathon project, a personal tool, or an open source contribution. Show us that you can ship.
Resilient and adaptable:
Factory environments are unpredictable. You are comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot quickly.
Bonus Points
Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, or industrial operations (even as an intern or summer job)
Familiarity with video data, computer vision, or camera integration
Past participation in hackathons or rapid prototyping events
Interest in mission driven work with real world impact
Why Join Us?
Be part of global scale ventured backed startup
Spend your days on real factory floors, learning how the physical world works from the people who run it
See your code in production within weeks, not months
Be part of a high-signal, low-ego team that moves fast
Official Certificate of Internship Completion
upon finishing the program
Potential to convert to full time after the internship

This role focuses on supporting a large-scale PLC code deployment and optimization initiative across multiple existing facilities. We’re a Series A startup backed by
Thrive Capital, Dylan Field, and Homebrew
. We’re looking for early team members to help us untangle the intersection of American industry, climate, and the economy.
The opportunity
Ambrook's platform engineers build the foundational systems that let the rest of the company build Ambrook better. This is a broad mandate: you'll work across product infrastructure, including our PostgreSQL databases and GCP environment, and company infrastructure, including internal tooling, data platforms, and the systems that power internal AI workflows. Most of our stack is TypeScript, with some GCP scripting you'll pick up on the job.
This role combines strong infrastructure judgment with a product mindset. You'll learn from the engineers and non-engineering teams who depend on the platform, iterate quickly for them, and defend the quality, security, and scalability standards that keep Ambrook dependable as we grow.
You'll also help build the infrastructure behind Ambrook's agentic systems. The focus isn't on building individual agents: it's on creating the shared frameworks, evals, loops, harnesses, sandboxes, and interfaces that let internal teams and customer-facing product teams build and operate agents with confidence. We're working toward a world where any team can request an agent, deploy it to the cloud, run evals, and see results on a dashboard. Your work will improve the experience of every employee and expand what the whole company can ship.

Build a working mental model of Ambrook's product and company infrastructure, including PostgreSQL, GCP, data systems, developer tooling, security foundations, and emerging agent infrastructure.
Develop relationships with engineering and non-engineering stakeholders to understand how they use the platform and where it creates friction.
Ship a meaningful infrastructure improvement to production that improves the codebase, developer experience, or internal tooling.
Identify and prioritize platform opportunities based on conversations with the teams who depend on these systems.

Own a platform project from discovery through production rollout that improves developer velocity, reliability, or scalability across the codebase.
Plan and execute a production database or GCP change with safe migration, validation, observability, and rollback practices.
Ship a useful slice of Ambrook's internal agent infrastructure, such as an interface for configuring agents, an evaluation system, or a harness for running agent loops.
Establish a tight feedback loop with internal platform customers and use it to improve what you build.

Expand shared agent infrastructure that supports both internal workflows and customer-facing agentic features, including reusable evals, harnesses, sandboxes, and operational tooling.
Drive a platform roadmap informed by internal customer needs, codebase-wide opportunities, and Ambrook's standards for quality, security, and scalability.
Deliver a substantial improvement to Ambrook's database, cloud, data, or developer infrastructure and help the broader engineering team adopt it.
Raise the standard for infrastructure changes through clear design, careful migration planning, and production ownership.

You have built and operated production platform or infrastructure systems, with hands-on experience in PostgreSQL and GCP.
You have planned and run migrations at scale, including validation, observability, and rollback strategies that protect production systems and customer data.

You treat engineers and non-engineering teams as platform customers. You learn how they work, build with empathy, and iterate from real feedback.
You can move quickly while defending the quality and scalability standards that shared infrastructure requires.
You are comfortable building the interfaces and supporting product surfaces that make infrastructure useful to internal teams.
You are security-minded and consider access, data handling, failure modes, and operational risk as part of ordinary engineering work.

Bonus: Experience building financial products or systems where auditability and data integrity matter.

Opiniion is a resident experience tool that partners with property management to create better living experiences for their residents. Our platform has helped thousands of property managers collect and act on real-time feedback, improve resident experiences, and enhance their online reputation. Opiniion is committed to exceptional service and innovation, earning recognition as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Driven by a forward-thinking team, we’re shaping the future of resident engagement. Our continued growth and commitment to innovation make this an exciting time to be part of our team!
LOCATION:
Lehi, UT
THE ROLE
As a Full-Stack Developer at Opiniion, you'll help build and improve the products our customers use every day, working across the stack to ship features, improve reliability, and support a fast-moving product and engineering team.
This seat leans toward the connective tissue of the platform: the integrations and data pipelines that connect Opiniion to the property management systems our clients run their businesses on. When that data flows correctly, operators can act on resident feedback in real time. When it doesn't, they're flying blind. You'll own a critical layer while still contributing across front-end and back-end product work as priorities shift.
What You'll Do
Build, maintain, and extend integrations with property management systems including Yardi, RealPage, and Entrata, handling API communication, authentication, data mapping, and error recovery.
Design integration patterns that are reusable across PMS platforms, reducing the effort to onboard new partners and data sources.
Own the reliability of production integrations: monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and incident response when pipelines fail or degrade.
Build and maintain ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, and load data from external PMS platforms and internal sources into our data infrastructure, including performant SQL transformations.
Partner with analytics engineering to keep upstream data quality high so downstream dashboards and reporting stay trustworthy.
Contribute across the full stack, from front-end product work to back-end services, as the team's priorities move.
How We Build With Ai
AI is part of how we build. We expect engineers to use AI tools thoughtfully in their daily development to move faster and ship better work, while keeping sound engineering judgment. Claude is our primary AI platform.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
True full-stack range: comfortable on the front end (JavaScript or TypeScript with a modern framework, Vue preferred, React welcome) and on the back end (services and APIs in Node.js and/or Python).
Strong SQL and solid relational data fundamentals (joins, CTEs, window functions, indexing).
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, including auth flows (OAuth, API keys, token refresh), pagination, rate limiting, and error handling.
Comfortable in AWS (RDS, S3, ECS or Lambda, IAM basics) and using Docker for local development.
Disciplined with Git, pull requests, CI/CD, testing, and clear documentation.
Meaningful time spent on integrations, ETL, or data engineering work.
Strong Python proficiency for building services, scripts, and pipeline logic.
How You Work
Ownership mindset: you treat what you ship as your responsibility, not just your code. When something breaks, you care about the fix and the prevention.
Strong communicator: you set clear expectations, surface problems early, and write things down so the team doesn't run on tribal knowledge.
Collaborative and low-ego: you give thoughtful code reviews, help teammates through blockers, and keep learning.
Autonomous: you can take a well-scoped problem and drive it to done, while knowing when to ask for help.
NICE-TO-HAVES
Experience integrating with property management systems (Yardi, RealPage, Entrata) or other proptech platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT tooling (Fivetran, Airflow, or custom pipeline orchestration).
Ruby on Rails experience.
Databricks or Spark SQL experience.
Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL data sources.
OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK
TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Vue.js, Node.js
AWS, Docker
MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Drizzle
GitHub, CircleCI
Opiniion’s Culture
At Opiniion, we take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously! We work hard together, and we have a lot of fun doing it. We are a team that believes in real autonomy: you own your area, solve problems, and move fast enough to actually see the change you make. The people here are invested in each other just as much as they’re invested in the work, and that combination is what makes this place different. We believe in collaboration, innovation, and building a team that truly cares—about our clients, their residents, and each other.

Comprehensive healthcare plans, encompassing medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with group life coverage. Opiniion covers 40-90% of the premium cost for employees and all dependents.
401(k) retirement plan with a 100% corporate match on the first 1% and 50% match on the next 5%.
Pre-tax Health Savings Accounts (HSA).
Paid Parental Leave for all new parents (including adoption or foster care).
Unlimited Time Off policies.
10 Paid Holidays annually.
Monthly Wellness Reimbursement benefit.

description_preview:
Convex is the backend platform that keeps up with you and your agents.
Our mission is to fundamentally change how software is built on the Internet by empowering developers to create fast, reliable, and dynamic apps without a backend team. We provide a full-stack app platform carefully designed with database, compute and backend abstractions that allow developers and LLMs to move fast but also create products that scale and remain simple over their lifetime.
The Team:
Convex has assembled a team that has built and designed some of the largest platforms in the world, and scaled companies to millions in revenue and thousands of employees. We’re a group of friendly, collaborative, and passionate people that love working in-person together in our office in San Francisco. We hire primarily in SF but have a few experienced folks working remotely in certain situations.
The Role:
Every week thousands of developers sign up for Convex, then start building and deploying on us. Some are kicking the tires. Some are quietly building the next big company. Your job is to help build the systems to find signal in the noise, and help us act. We’re looking for our first GTM Engineer to help us engage at just the right moment without being annoying about it.
You'll design, build, and ship the workflows and data infrastructure that turn product and market signal into pipeline, plus the internal apps and tools that compound our output. You'll walk in, audit what we have, decide what's missing, and start shipping.
Our users are developers, which makes this harder and more interesting than GTM engineering at most companies. Developers have antibodies against generic outbound, and the most valuable signal lives in product usage, not a lead form. We are deeply allergic to slop: the last thing the world needs is another ill-conceived cold email, and we won't ship one. Anything we send should be something a thoughtful person would be glad to receive. We’re not anti-AI by any means (helps us stay lean and move fast), and you'll be the person who keeps us on the right side of the line. The plays that work here are technical, specific, and earned, which is why we think the best version of this role is held by someone technical enough to build on Convex themselves.
What You'll Do:
Turn Convex product usage into the GTM signal it should be: model which deploys are getting serious, surface intent the moment a team crosses a threshold, and route it to the right play or the right human automatically.
Build agent + human-in-the-loop outbound that's genuinely useful, and keep it from ever becoming slop.
Build the AI agents and internal tools that compound the commercial team's output as we grow.
Audit the stack, generate your own backlog, and know when to reach for a point-and-click tool versus building something custom. Do the unglamorous data cleanup that makes all of it trustworthy.
Write a bunch of cool GTM code on Convex itself. We dogfood.
Measure your results and double down on what works best.
What Excites Us:
A few years spent building revenue and automation systems, whether you got there through Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, growth engineering, or as a software engineer who drifted toward the commercial side. You don't need "GTM Engineer" on your resume; the title barely existed a year ago, and we care far more about what you've built than what it was called.
Technical enough to build and wire systems together yourself. You don't have to be a career software engineer, but you're comfortable with APIs, data, and a bit of code (SQL, a scripting language, or TypeScript, which is what Convex itself is built in).
Hands-on experience inside a modern GTM stack.
Hands-on with AI in real work, not just in theory. You know where models are reliable and where they break, and you’re not afraid to fire up Claude Code or Codex to stand things up yourself rather than waiting on someone else.
Systems thinking: you consider what happens at 10x volume, when an API goes down, or when the same account hits your queue five times in parallel, and you design for it instead of leaving debt for someone else to unwind.
Bonus points for exposure to technical or developer-led sales motions, or genuine curiosity about Convex itself (building something small on it before you start wouldn't go unnoticed).
Interest in working in-person at Convex's office in SF.
Ideal Characteristics
This is an attempt to outline some characteristics of candidates who tend to thrive at Convex. We have a high demand for both commercial judgment and the ability to actually build, while also having the typical demands of a small startup.
Do they think in systems, not tasks?
The job is not to do GTM work faster by hand. It's to build the machine that does it. We want someone who, handed a recurring manual process, instinctively reaches for the version that runs itself. Someone who has built things that kept working after they walked away, and who measures their impact in leverage created, not hours logged.
Can they earn a developer's trust?
Developer tools are different. Your users are technical, skeptical, and quick to spot inauthenticity. The plays that work for a business app fall flat here. We want someone who understands, in their bones, what it feels like to be a developer evaluating a product, and who builds GTM motions that respect that instead of spamming through it.
Are they a commercially oriented builder?
The best GTM engineers we've met are hybrids: they care about revenue and they can ship. Not a marketer who can't build, not an engineer who doesn't care whether the work moves the business. We want someone who lives in the middle and is genuinely good at both.
Do they value simplicity and pragmatism?
Simplicity is at the heart of all good systems, and GTM systems are no different. Don't come here to build a Rube Goldberg machine of fifty chained automations. Come here because you want to get really good at achieving great things in the simplest possible

Job Description
This onsite Process Engineer role combines strong technical and project management skills to support both long‑term initiatives and day‑to‑day shop‑floor needs. While aligned with the core responsibilities of a Process Engineer, this position focuses on short‑term, project‑based support and offers an excellent opportunity for entry‑level engineers to learn and grow alongside experienced senior process engineers in a manufacturing and aerospace environment.

Assist Production Engineers with a wide range of operational and project tasks in support of production and process engineering activities.

Disposition parts when distress modes have established precedence, following approved technical guidance and standards.
Create and draft detailed reports documenting distress modes, findings, and recommendations to support engineering decisions.
Collect data using Standard Work templates to support requests for new technical data and process approvals.
Make changes to work instructions under the supervision of a Production Engineer, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and compliance.
Collaborate with cell personnel to identify process improvements and updates to work instructions that enhance safety, quality, and efficiency.

Assist Operations and Quality in developing process plans and maintaining compliance with internal procedures and external regulations.
Support daily production activities and small improvement efforts in collaboration with Production, Quality, and Maintenance teams.
Shadow engineers to learn equipment, systems, and repair processes, building practical knowledge of manufacturing and repair operations.

Complete export jurisdiction and classification training and apply this knowledge when working with technology subject to export control regulations.

08/31/2026
The Opportunity
Broker Tech builds products for the Convoy Platform at DAT, enabling brokers to match and execute shipments while they work seamlessly within their Transportation Management Systems (TMS). We partner with brokers to transform how they work, grow, and succeed by:
Empowering Matching: Building smarter tools and visibility that boost broker match rates and strengthen carrier connections.
Fueling Growth: Enabling brokers to expand through better pricing, new freight categories, and integrations.
Ensuring Payments: Strengthening and automating broker payment processes to reduce risk and ensure reliability.
Enabling Ideal Experiences: Delivering seamless workflows via APIs and webhooks between the Convoy Platform and TMSs, with self-service configuration and onboarding tools.
We care as much about how software runs in production as what it does. If you like understanding the full path from a code change to a healthy, observable, safely-deployed service, you'll fit in here.
What You'll Do
Hands-On Development
Write, test, and deploy production-quality code with guidance from senior engineers.
Build and maintain backend services in Node.js/TypeScript and contribute to React frontends as needed.
Implement and support message-driven workflows (Kafka/RabbitMQ) using existing patterns and reusable components.
Improve code quality and maintainability as you deliver features (tests, refactors, documentation).
Infrastructure & Reliability
Learn how our services are built, deployed, and operated (containers with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code with Terraform) and make changes to them with mentorship.
Add and improve observability (logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts) so the systems you touch are easy to reason about in production.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment practices (feature flags, staged rollouts, rollbacks).
Treat operational health as a feature: help tune alerts, reduce toil, and harden the services in your area.
Collaboration & Growth
Partner with product and business stakeholders to clarify requirements in a complex domain.
Participate in code reviews (both receiving and giving) and incorporate feedback quickly.
Learn the team's operational practices: monitoring, alerts, on-call support, and incident follow-ups.
Grow ownership over time: take on increasingly complex tickets, then small projects, including the infrastructure that supports them.
What Excites Us About This Role
As the Convoy platform expands into a critical marketplace for brokers, this team shapes outcomes that matter for broker workflows and reliability.
High ownership with support: you'll ship meaningful work while learning from senior engineers in a complex, real-world domain.
Lots of surface area: integrations, workflows, payments, messaging, partner-facing APIs, and the cloud infrastructure, pipelines, and observability that keep it all running.
What We're Looking For
1 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent).
Solid engineering fundamentals: debugging, testing, code quality, and clear written communication.
Familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js/JavaScript (or strong Java/C#/Go experience with willingness to ramp).
Familiarity with SQL databases (schema basics, writing queries, migrations with guidance).
Curiosity about how systems run in production (deployment, monitoring, and reliability) and a willingness to dig in.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotation and incident follow-ups (with support and training).
Bonus Skills
Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
Docker/Kubernetes familiarity.
CI/CD experience (tests in pipeline, safe deploy patterns, feature flags).
Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, OpenSearch/ELK, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar): dashboards, alerts, tracing.
Experience with microservices in production.
Hands-on exposure to Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS patterns (retries, DLQs, idempotency), or willingness to learn.
Comfort working with APIs (REST preferred; GraphQL a plus) and collaborating on contracts.
Familiarity with React and modern frontend development fundamentals.
Background in transportation/logistics or complex B2B integrations.
Why DAT?
DAT is an award winning employer of choice.
For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. Every business in America needs a bank account to exist. The system that decides whether they're real, who's behind them, and whether they're a risk, runs on infrastructure from the 1980s. We're rebuilding that layer from scratch.
Baselayer is the identity layer for institutions across the United States — the most complete business graph in America and every human tied to it. We fuse public records, IRS data, sanctions lists, web signals, and fraud telemetry from 2,200+ financial institutions into a single graph that resolves any business and the humans behind it in milliseconds. The legacy credit bureaus took 50 years to build something that gets 60% match rates. We've built something that gets 98% in under two years.
Today we're trusted by over 20% of financial institutions in America — including FIS, Rho, Socure and leading loan infrastructure providers. But the graph is becoming infrastructure for anyone who needs to know if a business is real and worth trusting: gig platforms, marketplaces, AI companies, and commerce infrastructure at scale.
Trust is the substrate of every financial transaction. We're rebuilding it.
ABOUT THE TEAM
We're solving real-time entity resolution at a scale no one else has cracked — fusing dozens of data sources into a single business identity graph and resolving any entity in milliseconds. It's a graph AI problem, a retrieval problem, and a fraud-modeling problem stacked on top of each other. The technical depth is real.
You'd be joining a small team where the data moat is defensible, the research problems are open, and the infrastructure you build becomes load-bearing for businesses. Ownership is real. Velocity is real. There's no layer of process between an idea and shipping it.
We're at an inflection point — the graph is built, the match rates speak for themselves, and the hardest problems are still ahead: graph embeddings, fraud propagation models across the business network, real-time traversal at sub-100ms latency, and expanding the identity layer beyond finance into every platform that needs to trust a business.
If you want to work on something foundational — the kind of infrastructure that gets built once and everything else runs on top of — this is it.
ABOUT THE ROLE
AI agents are beginning to act on behalf of people and businesses against publishers, banks, payment networks, and APIs. Every counterparty today answers identity questions on its own - self-asserted API keys, third-party cookies, pixel trackers. That model breaks the moment the actor is an agent. We're building KYA (Know Your Agent) - a cryptographic identity substrate that replaces self-assertion with third-party-issued credentials, verifiable by any counterparty. We're hiring an engineer to own a meaningful surface of the substrate - issuer mint, edge verification, Passport, or Merkle audit log - and ship it to production.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Build and maintain the runtime issuer/mint: OAuth Token Exchange (RFC 8693), JWS credentials (RFC 7515/7519, SD-JWT-VC), and Merkle audit log with real-time revocation.
Own and evolve the wire format and claim registry: JWT profile, verification_level/verification_method enums, and eIDAS/NIST IAL/FATF CDD crosswalk.
Implement sub-millisecond JWS verification and Web Bot Auth signature checks (RFC 9421) at the HTTP edge for counterparty CDNs, merchants, and publisher paywalls.
Build and maintain Passport - the user's cloud-resident principal account with canonical handle, KYC/KYB record, authorized-operators list, audit feed, and authenticator binding.
Develop operator integration: embedded KYB onboarding inside first OAuth 2.0 consent, per-operator opt-in, and webhook delivery via Svix.
Work across a Python 3.13 monorepo (FastAPI, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Run, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy) and Go for performance-critical substrate components.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Shipped systems where cryptographic correctness was load-bearing: OAuth/OIDC IdP, token issuer, signing service, HSM-backed signer, passkey/WebAuthn flow, or similar.
Fluent in Python and Go, or strong in one with a track record of learning the other quickly.
Reads RFCs as primary sources and holds informed opinions on JWK thumbprint canonicalization, pairwise-sub derivation, and Signature-Input header serialization.
Deep understanding of the distinction between identity and authorization, mandate and claim, snapshot and live state.
Production experience with async Python on Postgres, including migration safety and observability.
WHAT SETS YOU APART
Verifiable credentials / SSI / DID work - especially SD-JWT-VC, OID4VC, or the W3C VC stack.
Certificate Transparency, Trillian, or similar append-only-log experience.
KYC/KYB pipeline experience: provider abstraction, evidence retention, eIDAS/FATF CDD level mapping, ownership-chain resolution.
Edge/CDN engineering - Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Envoy filters, or mTLS at the edge.
Familiarity with AP2, x402, MPP, UCP, or Mastercard VI specs and how identity rides alongside mandate.
WORK LOCATION

Comfort using modern AI tooling pragmatically without confusing prototypes for production systems.

Introduction To The Team
Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
The Traveler Discovery & Planning team at Expedia is at the forefront of innovation in AI-driven agentic systems. We're dedicated to enhancing customer experiences, increasing engagement, and strengthening traveler relationships through cutting-edge machine learning solutions. Our work directly impacts millions of travelers worldwide, shaping their journey from dreaming to booking and beyond.
Join a team that’s focused on Agentic Experiences revolutionizing traveler experiences through autonomous, intelligent agent systems. From building cutting-edge conversational AI that anticipates traveler needs to developing proactive solutions for personalized trip planning, your work will shape the future of travel assistance and directly impact millions of users worldwide. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational systems in a high-impact domain, backed by Expedia’s AI-first vision.
In This Role, You Will
Design, build, and evaluate multi-step agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents capable of planning, tool use, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration
Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques in agentic architectures, such as ReAct, reflection loops, chain-of-thought prompting, and tool-augmented reasoning
Develop and maintain agent orchestration frameworks, defining how agents decompose tasks, delegate to sub-agents, and handle failure and recovery
Integrate large language models (LLMs) with external tools, APIs, databases, and code execution environments to enable real-world task completion
Define and own evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, measuring task success, reliability, latency, cost, and safety across diverse benchmarks and production scenarios
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to translate business requirements into agentic system designs and deliver production-grade solutions
Identify and mitigate risks specific to agentic systems, including prompt injection, unintended actions, hallucination in long-horizon tasks, and unsafe tool use
Stay current with the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape, synthesizing academic research and industry developments to inform the team's technical direction
Mentor junior ML engineers and scientists, providing technical guidance on agentic design patterns, LLM best practices, and experimentation methodology
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years of related industry experience
Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agentic or multi-step AI systems (e.g., ReAct, tool-calling agents, multi-agent pipelines) in production or research settings
Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX); experience with LLM APIs and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, and structured data sources for real-world task completion
Solid understanding of prompt engineering techniques including chain-of-thought, few-shot prompting, and structured output generation
Experience defining and running evaluation frameworks for ML systems, including offline benchmarking and production monitoring
Preferred Qualifications
PhD, MS, or BS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
Experience in the travel or e-commerce industry
Publications in top-tier ML conferences or journals
Patented Inventions, pending and issued
Contributions to open-source ML projects
Experience taking models from prototype to production in collaboration with Machine Learning Engineering teams
